parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The natural language in which responses are returned. Valid values:

*   **zh-CN**: Chinese. This is the default value.
*   **en-US**: English.
*   **ja**: Japanese.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost describe-regions --accept-language zh-CN --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
